correctness.rationale: Independence forces all positive labels into one part; Roman domination forces that part to be entirely positive and to contain a label 2. The converse is immediate. Coefficient, minimum, minimum-count, and reconstruction arguments follow algebraically and are checked exhaustively through order 9.
